gate.run: node -e "(async()=>{const s=new URL(process.env.SITE_URL).origin;const t=await(await fetch(s+'/')).text();const slugs=['r1','r2',...[...t.matchAll(/\/floors\/(\w+)/g)].map((m)=>m[1])];let h=null;for(const g of slugs){const m=(await(await fetch(s+'/floors/'+g)).text()).match(/\/f\/(0x[0-9a-f]+)/);if(m){h=m[1];break}}if(!h){console.log('NO FLOOR ON THE SITE');process.exit(1)}const r=await fetch(s+'/f/'+h,{headers:{'x-forwarded-host':'evil.example'}});const c=r.headers.get('cache-control')||'';const a=((r.headers.get('content-security-policy')||'').match(/frame-ancestors ([^;]*)/)||[])[1]||'';const ok=r.status===200&&c==='no-store'&&a.split(' ')[0]===s&&!a.includes('evil');console.log(ok?'FLOOR HEADERS OK':'FLOOR HEADERS WRONG: status '+r.status+', cache-control '+c+', frame-ancestors '+a);process.exit(ok?0:1)})()"
